summary: Updated Phase 2 Final Remediation Plan specifying standalone atomic deleteHabitPermanentlySync() (without calling deleteHabitWithUndoSync() or generating a HABIT_DELETION UndoToken), selective invalidation of active UndoTokens belonging to the deleted habit while preserving unrelated habits' UndoTokens, updated ViewModel/dialog messages without Undo promises, and full regression test coverage.
